parameters.title: The primary heading.
parameters.leading: Places a widget before the main label.
parameters.trailing: A figure or a ComicTag beside the title, or below when it needs more room.
parameters.action: Places a secondary action beside the row’s contents.
parameters.isFirst: Applies the treatment for the first row in a group.
parameters.label: Overrides the spoken row name.
parameters.enabled: Controls whether the row accepts input.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
parameters.subtitle: Adds a second line below the title.

keyboardNote: Comic uses the row’s title as its default accessible name. The example supplies label so a screen reader also gets the updated read status.
